name: Special City Council Meeting- 4:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting- 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 9, 2021 -
4:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
AGENDA ITEMS
4A.
Introduction of Proposed Fiscal Year 2021-22 and FY 2022-23 Operating Budget. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
1) Review proposed FY 2021-22 and FY 2022-23 operating budget; 2) Receive public input; 3) Identify revisions to the proposed FY 2021-22 and FY 2022-23 operating budget to be brought back for final consideration and adoption on June 23, 2021; and 4) Provide direction to staff regarding funding for decision package proposals.
2021-06-09 Special Meeting Item 04A Introduction of Operating Budget - Updated 06-08-2021
4B.
Introduction of the proposed Fiscal Year 2021-2022 through FY 2027-2027 Financial Plan and Capital Improvement Program (CIP). Contact Persons: Finance Director McBroome and Finance Manager Attili
1) Review the proposed CIP; 2) Accept public input on the proposed CIP; and 3) Provide feedback and requested changes to the proposed CIP for final consideration and approval on June 23, 2021.
2021-06-09 Special Meeting Item 04B Introduction to CIP
4.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JUNE 16, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
